releaseNotes:
## Calendar
- New Calendar page for house events, separate from guest stays
- Each event is a day note, so it also appears on Daily, Weekly, and Monthly
- Categories have their own colors, with a color key on the month view
- Events can repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly until an end date
- Changing or deleting a repeat asks whether to update this date, this and following dates, or all dates
- Month changes use the same year and month buttons as the booking month page

## Notes
- Day notes can include a category and an optional end time

## Access
- Calendar is its own page permission
- Roles that already had Daily, Weekly, or Monthly also get Calendar
